body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.1 (naive base rate 0.5) that: net profit after tax for the quarter ended 31-Mar-2027, as first reported, is >= Rs 67 cr (10% x Rs 2,676 cr net worth / 4). Our reasoning: Needs PPOP ~Rs 160 cr+ with credit cost ~2% inside two quarters; from Q2's -70 that is a Rs 137 cr swing; past profitability dates (May-2025: after H1 FY26) were missed. Naive base: Generic guidance-met rate (L26) [EST 0.5]. Resolution: YES if net profit after tax for the quarter ended 31-Mar-2027, as first reported, is >= Rs 67 cr (10% x Rs 2,676 cr net worth / 4). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL / press release Q4 FY27. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
